mapper.select: SELECT chat_num, lost_num, found_num, user_id_a, user_id_b, created_at FROM chat_room WHERE ( (#{lostNum} IS NOT NULL AND lost_num = #{lostNum}) OR (#{foundNum} IS NOT NULL AND found_num = #{foundNum}) ) AND ( (user_id_a = #{userIdA} AND user_id_b = #{userIdB}) OR (user_id_a = #{userIdB} AND user_id_b = #{userIdA}) ) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room ( lost_num, found_num, user_id_a, user_id_b ) VALUES ( #{lostNum}, #{foundNum}, #{userIdA}, #{userIdB} )
mapper.select: SELECT chat_num, lost_num, found_num, user_id_a, user_id_b, created_at FROM chat_room WHERE chat_num = #{chatNum}
